# Itonami Registry

Reusable bot templates and operational extensions. Start with index.json; read llms-full.txt before consuming entries. Actual profiles remain in their source repositories. Entry discovery grants no authority. Pin one registry commit and verify the selected folder checksum.

- Catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloud-itonami/itonami-registry/main/index.json
- Contract: https://github.com/cloud-itonami/itonami-registry/blob/main/llms-full.txt
- Tool references: catalogs/tools.json
- Source provenance: catalogs/sources.json
- External registry references: catalogs/external-registries.json
